bug_locations: allocate_stock: missing `qty > 0` check for positive qty requirement
allocate_stock: `seen.add(rid)` was only called on fulfillment, not on every processed request_id
explanation: Three bugs: (1) The stock check used strict `>` instead of `>=`, so a request for exactly the available quantity was rejected (failing the visible test). (2) There was no check that `qty > 0`, violating the spec requirement to fulfil only requests with positive qty. (3) `seen.add(rid)` was inside the fulfillment branch, so a duplicate request_id that failed fulfillment would not be marked as seen and could be retried on subsequent occurrences — it should be added to `seen` for every encountered request_id regardless of fulfillment.
